messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager (P2): metering.alerts.token_count_gap - Live tally falling behind shadow for eu-west emitters (~12% under) starting ~2026-03-21T11:05Z. Potential false overage flags.
nick-oncall: taking the pager. Paging @aline-billing and @kai-sre. Any deploys or config changes in last hour?
aline-billing: no deploys. I'm seeing an uptick in overage_flags for eu-west accounts (sample ids: 77a9b, 88c2d). Shadow counts look nominal.
kai-sre: checking ingest pipeline and consumer offsets. Running quick checks.
nick-oncall: please confirm customer-facing emails paused if it's false positive.
ops-bot: query: kafka_consumer_lag meter-ingest-group (eu-west partitions) -> partition 1 lag=21500, partition 2 lag=0, partition 3 lag=0
kai-sre: looks like a single shard/partition stalled on emitter-ingest-4. Logs show repeated "GC pause > 5s" and periodic "java.lang.OutOfMemoryError" before process restart attempts.
ops-bot: k8s: cordon node eu-ingest-04; restarting pod/emitter-ingest-4.
prod-bot: config: temporarily disabled billing.automated_emails.region[eu-west] = true -> false
lina-cs: pausing escalation, CS notified top-5 affected customers that we're investigating.
aline-billing: 5 customers flagged; haven't billed yet. We'll hold charges until recon completes.
kai-sre: pod restarted, consumer lag trending down to ~1200 and falling. Starting local commit replay for the window 2026-03-21T10:30Z-11:10Z to fill missing emits.
nick-oncall: what's ETA on replay/backfill?
kai-sre: estimate ~20-25m for replay + reconciler. Kicking off `metering-replay --from 2026-03-21T10:30Z --to 2026-03-21T11:10Z --shard 1` now. job_id=replay-1769954321-a
ops-bot: replay job replay-1769954321-a status: queued -> running -> 15%
aline-billing: can we auto-clear flags if recon fills gap? We should ensure no customer is charged.
nick-oncall: set policy: auto-clear overage_flags if recon reports delta <0.5% for that account in the window. @aline-billing agreed?
aline-billing: agreed. Implemented for this incident.
lina-cs: doing manual outreach to the 5 customers; drafted message pre-approved by legal.
ops-bot: replay job progress: 15% -> 55% -> 100%
kai-sre: replay finished. Kicking reconciler: `billing-reconcile --job replay-1769954321-a --apply-retractions` -> recon-id=rec-20260321-11-40
aline-billing: reconciler completed: all 5 flagged customers cleared, no invoices generated. CS confirms two customers acknowledged and closed.
nick-oncall: TL;DR root cause = single emitter consumer experiencing repeated GC/oom leading to delayed commits -> live tally lag -> alerting/rules kicked in causing overage flags. Mitigations: restarted pod, replay+reconcile, paused emails.
prod-bot: follow-ups created: PM-3421 (add jittered restart/backoff + heap settings) owner @kai-sre; BILL-1283 (add safetynet threshold to suppress 10m transient drifts) owner @aline-billing; SRE-2145 (heapdump on OOM + liveness probe) owner @kai-sre.
kai-sre: immediate actions: bump JVM heap on emitter-ingest to +20%, add heapdump on oom, add readiness probe that fails fast on long GC, and increase kafka commit timeout from 30s -> 90s. Will monitor for 2 days.
ick-oncall: leaving bridge open for 30m while metrics stabilize. Great work team.
incident-bot: Pager cleared: metering.alerts.token_count_gap - severity=P2 - duration=48m
